# Save to Camera Roll

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Saves the given image to the camera roll.

## Syntax

~~~~text
saveToCameraRoll(image: <#Variable (Optional)#>, album: <#Album (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
saveToCameraRoll(image: avatar, album: a-Profiles)
~~~~
